status_semantics.rule: Design mapping does not imply implementation. A feature may be marked implemented/built/tested only with linked repository evidence and test evidence.

ownership_and_mapping_rules: Every stable feature ID is preserved from the source catalog.
Each feature has exactly one proposed primary logical owner; secondary contributors belong in dependency edges.
Every feature must link to one or more manifest requirement/component records before approval.
Acceptance criteria and test cases must be feature-specific; generic engine tests are insufficient.
A feature is not complete merely because its parent engine specification exists.
Applicability is decided per project and target, not globally by deleting catalog entries.
No feature status is advanced automatically by documentation creation.
